$comment: Maps a Playwright screenshot name (from toHaveScreenshot('NAME.png')) to its destination under assets/img/. `npm run sync-docs` copies each captured baseline to its destination. Unlike the agentgateway harness, destinations here are a single path rather than a light/dark pair: the Keycloak 22 admin console has no dark theme, so the guides point both reuse-image shortcodes at the one asset. If a future Keycloak gains a dark console, widen this to {"light": ..., "dark": ...} and add the theme dimension to playwright.config.ts in the same change. A capture with no entry here is still diffed for regression but never reaches the docs.
